quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qiu Wensheng (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 2026 revenue by business - mobile terminals RMB 411.2 hundred million, up 16.6% YoY; AIoT RMB 60.4 hundred million, up 84.5%; computing and data RMB 433.2 hundred million, up 2.8%; innovation business RMB 25.4 hundred million, up 134.9%. H1 ROE was 10.5%, up 2.4 percentage points YoY (21.0% annualised), and operating cash flow was positive despite supply-chain pressure on the industry. He said revenue grew from RMB 853 hundred million in its A-share listing year to RMB 1714 hundred million in 2025 and will exceed RMB 2000 hundred million in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026: mobile RMB 411.2 hundred million (+16.6%); AIoT RMB 60.4 hundred million (+84.5%); computing and data RMB 433.2 hundred million (+2.8%); innovation RMB 25.4 hundred million (+134.9%); ROE 10.5%

quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and CFO Xi Pinghua (H1 2026 results briefing): upstream supply-chain prices rose quickly in H1 2026, so the company hedged and inventory rose clearly in Q2; part of it is proactive stocking of items with large price rises - memory, PCBs and high-end MLCCs. Most memory is supplied by customers, so price swings basically do not affect its gross profit, while for self-purchased memory it stocked strategically in advance. She said the inventory matches firm orders with no impairment risk, inventory aged over 90 days is very low and finished-goods inventory stays low. The debt-to-asset ratio is above 75%, reflecting fast growth, global capacity build-out, smart-manufacturing upgrades and strategic stocking of key raw materials; the company plans to keep lowering it over the next three years and expects higher revenue and profit growth in 2027, with continued improvement in the debt ratio and cash flow.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Li Yutao (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 2026 non-recurring profit came mainly from investment income on stakes in upstream and downstream industry-chain companies (vertical integration, horizontal expansion and strategic investments in partners); she said these equity ties help lock in key components, core processes and capacity, and the company expects such investments to contribute investment income on the order of several hundred million RMB a year. She described the '3+N+3' platform: consumer electronics as the base, the data-center business (AI servers, supernodes, general-purpose servers, switches) as the growth engine for the next few years, and automotive electronics and robotics as longer-term options.
quarterly_data.figure: investment income expected at several hundred million RMB a year
